SELECT 
    cr.clientref AS "ID",
    ea.liqassets AS "liquid",
    ea.totassets AS "total assets",
    ROUND(ea.liqassets::numeric / ea.totassets, 4) AS "liquidity measure",
    ei.mthincome AS "monthly income",
    ea.investamt AS "investment amount",
    CASE 
        WHEN ea.liqassets::numeric / ea.totassets > 0.3 AND ei.mthincome > 5000 THEN 'Target'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS "label of their investment potential"
FROM core_record cr
JOIN employment_and_income ei ON cr.coreregistry = ei.emplcoreref
JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ei.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref
